warnings: Snapback's final package confirmation was staged/dry-run only. No public distribution or hosted deployment credit is awarded, but the installed-package path did work for all 5 apps.
The deep-round Snapback Research capsule was product-blocked; the rating uses the remediated final confirmation while retaining the original defect as maturity context.
Convex Research Room carries a provider Stop-class control-secret-in-argv defect and is ineligible as go-to for that application.
Supabase Research Room had builder evidence-redaction Stops, not provider disclosure; the credential-bearing CLI output still informs operations and agent usability.
Firebase logout does not erase persistent Firestore IndexedDB bytes; future server access was correctly denied.
InstantDB Partiful retained stale protected state for 12 seconds after a permission transition; reasonable reviewers may score auth or correctness lower.
Todo and Chat final Snapback latency receipts were collected on Linux despite a stale embedded Mac label and are excluded from cross-machine comparison.
Supabase cold SUBSCRIBED readiness missed an immediate write in more than one arm and is treated as realtime friction.

The reviewer returned semantically complete ratings in a nonconforming envelope. The coordinator preserved every numeric rating, Stop, and recommendation, normalized field names and nesting, and compressed some rationales and evidence lists for the strict retained artifact; the raw reviewer text remains addressable by session ID and SHA-256 in the audit report.

provisionalGoTo.reason: Firebase is the most consistent complete product across the five apps, with uniquely strong retained offline behavior and a mature integrated surface. Supabase is the strongest conditional alternative for relational and search-heavy products; Convex is strongest when authoring coherence and reactive queries dominate, subject to its Research Room Stop.
